wrong_claims: Storefront_Tag__c.Tag__c is a restricted picklist of tags (Vegan, Late Night, Halal, ...), reported by AskCoworker and repeated in 'Candidates examined and rejected'. Storefront_Tag__c has no Tag__c field: describe and Tooling CustomField show only a Storefront__c lookup (the Tag fields belong to sc_ext/shield_ext__Tag_Assignment__c).

defects.defect: A wrong AskCoworker claim about a non-existent field (Storefront_Tag__c.Tag__c) was repeated in the rejected-candidates list without checking it. One describe call would have exposed it.
defects.skill_gap: Partial: the skill says to verify AskCoworker claims the design depends on, but has no rule for rejected candidates. Add: verify the existence of any component named in the spec, including rejected candidates, or drop it.

defects.defect: The design rests on an untestable platform assumption: a local picklist cannot be re-pointed to an existing GlobalValueSet, and only one field can be promoted. That assumption drives 3 Creates, 3 Deletes, and 4 Updates. It is labelled load-bearing with a sandbox validate-only check, which is honest, but the whole inventory could collapse.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: no guidance on when a load-bearing assumption dominates the inventory (for example, present both inventories or make the check a blocking prerequisite).

defects.defect: The GlobalValueSet Create and the Storefront__c.Cuisine__c Update are really one manual Setup 'Promote to Global Value Set' action. Listing them as deployable Create/Update rows with a force-app module is misleading.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: spec-format has no way to represent Setup-only operations.
